# Upgrading a project from v1: what v2 gives it

A project recording v1 may carry a verification surface in the v1 form: a harness with its
feature map, an eval suite or a reader-task list, with a README, statuses and a repository check.
Of what v2 added, only the ADR conventions change lasts. Its fixed feature-map shape and the
feature-map bullet beside it are not offered, since a later version replaces the feature map
itself; a v1 feature map is part of the surface a later guide's move carries into recipes.

Offer, as its own item and as a default the project may adapt or decline where its own way already
does the job:

1. **The ADR conventions' records-in-effect rule**, by comparison per the update pass: only an
   `Accepted` record is in effect, and backfilling `Enforced by`, building a `not yet` check, and
   citing a record as a ruling read only records in effect.
